name: Dabrafenib
mechanism: ATP-competitive inhibitor of BRAF V600-mutant kinase (class I monomers). Used with trametinib to achieve vertical MAPK inhibition and reduce paradoxical MAPK activation in wild-type cells.
keyToxicities: Pyrexia (characteristic, sometimes with rigors, hypotension and dehydration)
Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma and new primary malignancies (reduced with MEK co-inhibition)
monitoring: Temperature monitoring with prompt interruption for pyrexia
interactions: Dabrafenib is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 inducer and may reduce efficacy of hormonal contraceptives and other substrates; avoid strong CYP3A4/CYP2C8 inhibitors.
resistance: MAPK reactivation (NRAS/KRAS mutations, MEK mutations, BRAF amplification or splice variants) and PI3K pathway activation.
